vectors.name: JCS and SHA-256 policy digest fixture
no applicable rule defaults to deny
policy order does not change result
typed equality does not coerce string to boolean
wildcard and alias resource matching are unsupported
indeterminate overrides an otherwise applicable permit
combination remains indeterminate when policy order is reversed
exists on an absent attribute is false, so the rule is not applicable

policy_digest_handling: Decision vectors exercise the pure evaluator with policy bundles treated as already resolved and digest-verified by the harness. In these evaluator-only fixtures, the all-zero 32-byte digest is a sentinel and MUST NOT be used as a digest known-answer value. Policy digest computation is tested independently by pol-kat-001.
